messages:
maria: Heads up — since the autoscaler burst last night we're seeing OTEL spans drop around GPU eviction cycles. p99 trace latency spikes and missing child spans in traces. Prometheus alert: otel_collector_span_dropout_rate > 0.5%.
ajay: Any dashboard link? /cc @zoe
maria: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abcd/wf-otel?panelId=7
maria: Logs: `batch_processor: dropped 342 spans due to queue overflow` around 02:14 UTC
zoe: Is this from the collector config we rolled last week? I changed backpressure settings. Here's the relevant snippet:
```
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 10s
    send_batch_size: 512
    drop_on_overflow: true
```
ajay: `drop_on_overflow=true` will discard spans when queue is full — that matches missing child spans. We should set it false and tune queue_size or throttle upstream.
kai: We also hit network egress cap on ap-south-1 during scale. `tc qdisc` shows drops; collector batching likely makes bursts. @maria can you post pod/node metrics: otel_collector_queue_length and node_network_transmit_errs_total?
maria: Pulled metrics: queue length peaked at 48k, node tx errs spiked. GPU node provision delayed ~8m due to AZ imbalance. Thoughts on podAntiAffinity tweak?
zoe: Quick mitigation: lower `send_batch_size` to 128, set `drop_on_overflow: false`, and bump collector memory +512Mi. Longer term: autoscaler smoothing for batchy workloads.
ajay: I'll mute the alert for 30m while we test. Need a short runbook: check queue, check network errs, update batch config, redeploy, verify `otel_collector_dropped_spans_total` panel.
maria: Adding runbook + PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5412. Testing in staging now.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: deployment `otel-collector` started in staging (rollout_id=otc-20260316-3).
zoe: Staging logs show no drops after change; p95 latency improved. Plan to roll to prod after 1h green.
ajay: :thumbsup:
